standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforward of a bounded below complex of right acyclic quasi-coherent modules computes the derived pushforward
standard_prerequisites.use: Finishes the proof once the complex has been made bounded below.

standard_prerequisites.name: The zeroth higher direct image of the complex agrees with that of a suitable truncation from below, because of quasi-coherence of the direct image of the terms
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the proof replace the complex by a bounded below one without changing the degree zero computation.

core_obligations: Observe that there is always a canonical map from the pushforward of the complex to its derived pushforward, and that it suffices to prove it is an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves (proof lines 739-741).
Reduce to degree zero: since the statement is invariant under shifts, it is enough to show the comparison is an isomorphism on the zeroth cohomology sheaf (proof lines 741-743).

Reduce to an affine base, where the quasi-coherence of the direct images can be used, and replace the complex by a truncation from below: the zeroth higher direct image of the complex agrees with that of the truncation because of quasi-coherence (proof lines 743-749).
With the complex bounded below and all its terms right acyclic for the pushforward, conclude that the comparison map is a quasi-isomorphism by Leray acyclicity (proof lines 750-754).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the isomorphism on the zeroth cohomology sheaf (proof lines 739-743).
Pass to an affine base and truncate below using quasi-coherence (proof lines 743-749).
Apply Leray acyclicity to the now bounded below complex (proof lines 750-754).
